# Building a local repository {.dark-slide background-color="#111C26"}

[BLOCK 6 &middot; PART A]{.eyebrow}

::: {.accent-bar}
:::

[Resolve, download, index.]{.subhead}

## Why a local repository

- **Not affected by CRAN archiving.** The tarballs you depend on are on your
  disk.
- **A directory you can copy.** You can `tar` it, checksum it, and move it to
  an air-gapped network.
- **A release unit.** "Version 2026.09 of our R environment" becomes one
  directory with a checksum.

It works with plain `install.packages()`.

## Resolve the package set

::: {.demo-label}
Live
:::

```r
options(repos = c(
  CRAN = "https://packagemanager.posit.co/cran/2026-06-01"
))

requested <- c("xml2", "R6")

ap    <- available.packages()
wants <- unique(c(requested,
                  unlist(tools::package_dependencies(requested, ap,
                                                     recursive = TRUE))))

# drop base and recommended -- they ship with R
wants <- setdiff(wants, rownames(installed.packages(priority = c("base", "recommended"))))
wants
```

```text
[1] "xml2" "R6" "cli" "rlang"
```

The source is a dated snapshot, so the same code resolves to the same set
later.

## Download the tarballs

```r
repo <- "/opt/pkgrepo"
dir.create(file.path(repo, "src", "contrib"), recursive = TRUE)

got <- download.packages(wants,
                         destdir = file.path(repo, "src", "contrib"),
                         type    = "source")
got
```

```text
     [,1]    [,2]
[1,] "xml2"  "/opt/pkgrepo/src/contrib/xml2_1.5.2.tar.gz"
[2,] "R6"    "/opt/pkgrepo/src/contrib/R6_2.6.1.tar.gz"
[3,] "cli"   "/opt/pkgrepo/src/contrib/cli_3.6.6.tar.gz"
[4,] "rlang" "/opt/pkgrepo/src/contrib/rlang_1.2.0.tar.gz"
```

::: {.note}
[Keep `got`]{.note-label}
`download.packages()` returns the names and file paths of what it actually
downloaded
([`?download.packages`](https://stat.ethz.ch/R-manual/R-devel/library/utils/html/download.packages.html)).
Write it to a CSV next to the repository as the manifest.
:::

## Index with `write_PACKAGES()`

```r
tools::write_PACKAGES(file.path(repo, "src", "contrib"), verbose = TRUE)
```

```text
Processing packages:
  /opt/pkgrepo/src/contrib/cli_3.6.6.tar.gz
  /opt/pkgrepo/src/contrib/R6_2.6.1.tar.gz
  /opt/pkgrepo/src/contrib/rlang_1.2.0.tar.gz
  /opt/pkgrepo/src/contrib/xml2_1.5.2.tar.gz
done
```

```r
list.files(file.path(repo, "src", "contrib"))
```

```text
[1] "cli_3.6.6.tar.gz"   "PACKAGES"           "PACKAGES.gz"
[4] "PACKAGES.rds"       "R6_2.6.1.tar.gz"    "rlang_1.2.0.tar.gz"
[7] "xml2_1.5.2.tar.gz"
```

Tarballs plus `PACKAGES` is a complete R repository.

## The generated `PACKAGES`

```bash
cat /opt/pkgrepo/src/contrib/PACKAGES
```

```text
Package: cli
Version: 3.6.6
Depends: R (>= 3.4)
Imports: utils
...

Package: R6
Version: 2.6.1
Depends: R (>= 3.6)
Suggests: lobstr, testthat (>= 3.0.0)
License: MIT + file LICENSE
MD5sum: b33833f3cbd24baf862a2c87b5bae13a
NeedsCompilation: no
...
```

`write_PACKAGES()` reads each tarball's `DESCRIPTION` and writes a fixed
set of fields. `SystemRequirements` is not one of them, but you can add it
with `fields = "SystemRequirements"`
([`?write_PACKAGES`](https://stat.ethz.ch/R-manual/R-devel/library/tools/html/writePACKAGES.html)).

## Install from it

::: {.demo-label}
Live
:::

```r
available.packages(repos = "file:///opt/pkgrepo")[, c("Version", "Repository")]
```

```text
      Version Repository
cli   "3.6.6" "file:///opt/pkgrepo/src/contrib"
R6    "2.6.1" "file:///opt/pkgrepo/src/contrib"
rlang "1.2.0" "file:///opt/pkgrepo/src/contrib"
xml2  "1.5.2" "file:///opt/pkgrepo/src/contrib"
```

`xml2` compiles against `libxml2`. This is the block 5 container, which
already has `libxml2-dev`:

```r
dir.create("/tmp/testlib")
.libPaths("/tmp/testlib", include.site = FALSE)   # hide the site library
install.packages("xml2", repos = "file:///opt/pkgrepo")
```

With the site library hidden, `cli` and `rlang` are resolved from the
repository and installed before `xml2`, as with any other repository.

## Serving the repository

| How | When |
|---|---|
| `file:///opt/pkgrepo` | One server, or a shared NFS mount |
| Any static web server | Several machines |
| Posit Package Manager | You also want binaries and dated snapshots |

```nginx
server {
  listen 80;
  server_name pkgs.example.com;
  root /opt/pkgrepo;
  autoindex on;
}
```

Then in `Rprofile.site`:

```r
options(repos = c(INTERNAL = "http://pkgs.example.com"))
```

## `write_PACKAGES()` arguments

```r
tools::write_PACKAGES(
  dir            = "/opt/pkgrepo/src/contrib",
  type           = "source",      # or a binary type, e.g. "win.binary"
  latestOnly     = TRUE,          # index only the newest of each package
  addFiles       = FALSE,
  verbose        = TRUE,
  fields         = NULL           # extra fields, e.g. "SystemRequirements"
)
```

::: {.note}
[`latestOnly`]{.note-label}
`TRUE` is the default: one version per package, as on CRAN. `FALSE` also
indexes older versions
([`?write_PACKAGES`](https://stat.ethz.ch/R-manual/R-devel/library/tools/html/writePACKAGES.html)).
:::

Re-run `write_PACKAGES()` after every change to the directory. A tarball
that is not in `PACKAGES` is not visible to R.
